response.headline: Below target at {{pct_of_target}}, with premium {{wow_direction}} {{wow_change_pct}}
paragraphs: The agency wrote {{total_premium}} across {{policies_written}} policies, short of the combined target of {{target_total}}. Life was the busiest line by count with {{line.life.policies}} policies, and retention held at {{retention_rate}}.

No producer was well ahead this week, and several finished just under their number. Luis Ortega did not keep all of his renewals, and Grant Fowler is at {{producer.grant_fowler.pct_of_target}} of target. The file does not show the reasons, so both are worth a quick check-in.
